title: Pi web-access extension configuration
description: Configuration for configs/agents/pi/extensions/web-access, normally stored at ~/.pi/web-search.json.

$schema.description: Optional editor schema reference. From ~/.pi/web-search.json, use ./agent/extensions/web-access/web-search.schema.json.

exaApiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable name that contains the Exa API key. Prefer this over exaApiKey so secrets stay out of files.

exaApiKey.description: Literal Exa API key. Prefer exaApiKeyEnv for normal use.

braveProfile.description: Brave browser profile name used for browser-cookie based features when a feature-specific profile is not set.

chromeProfile.description: Chromium/Chrome profile name used for browser-cookie based features when braveProfile and feature-specific profiles are not set.

medium.description: Medium-specific authenticated fetch support using cookies from a local browser profile. Cookies are only sent to medium.com or *.medium.com.

enabled.description: Enable local browser-cookie backed HTTP fetches for Medium URLs before public/external fetch providers are tried.

profile.description: Browser profile to read Medium cookies from. Falls back to braveProfile, then chromeProfile, then the browser default profile.

enabled.description: Enable Gemini Web backed YouTube transcript/content extraction.

preferredModel.description: Gemini Web model used for YouTube content extraction unless the tool call supplies a model override.

githubClone.description: GitHub repository clone settings for GitHub URL fetches.

enabled.description: Enable GitHub repository cloning for supported GitHub URLs.

maxRepoSizeMB.description: Accepted by the config normalizer, but the current clone implementation does not enforce a size limit.

clonePath.description: Parent directory used for temporary GitHub clones.
